question.text: The B Impact Assessment (administered by B Lab, and the basis for B Corp certification) is:

answer.text: A free online diagnostic tool scoring a company across governance, workers, community, environment and customers — used for B Corp certification above an 80-point threshold
A SEBI circular for listed mutual funds

explanation.text: The Logic: The B Impact Assessment (BIA), administered by B Lab, is a free online diagnostic tool that scores a company across five categories — governance, workers, community, environment, and customers. Companies scoring at or above the 80-point threshold can pursue B Corp certification, a third-party verified status for mission-aligned businesses. The Trap: Option B (SEBI circular) and Option C (Section 80G donation deduction) are unrelated regulatory items. Option D conflates BIA with IRIS+, which is a separate impact-metrics catalogue, not the same instrument. Note: The B Impact Assessment, B Lab, B Corp certification, the 80-point threshold and the five-category structure are not described in the cited Social Impact Assessors Certification Examination Workbook (January 2026) pages 57 or 145-147. Those pages discuss FPSE/Section 8/SIA, IRIS+, GIIRS, GRI and UNGC. The framing above reflects general industry knowledge of investor-facing impact-assessment frameworks.
